facts.value: Use this free Project Budget Template for Excel to manage your projects better.
There are certain features or characteristics that are unique to projects and differentiate them from the daily operations or other types of activities of an organization.
Any Project Needs a Project Manager and a Project Team.

While the structure of project teams might change from one organization to another, projects usually involve a project manager and a team of individuals with the necessary skills to execute the tasks that are needed.
